failure_conditions.condition: A factual claim, citation, technical statement, calculation, interpretation, source representation, or comparable epistemic artefact is generated, retrieved, transformed, inferred, or synthesised. This includes an attributable operative interpretation of materially relevant file, tool, environmental, system or conversational state; observable process evidence is required, not a presumed internal belief.

The output has an evidenced intended purpose or downstream task for which factual accuracy, evidentiary fidelity, technical correctness, source integrity, traceability, uncertainty handling or equivalent epistemic assurance is materially consequential; identify the requirement for the actual workflow stage, including any drafting function. The purpose may be an internal decision, tool selection, action continuation or recovery, not only a human-facing output. Identify the information reasonably available at that decision point.
failure_conditions.assessment: Police draft purpose requires material event fidelity.

failure_conditions.condition: The content accuracy, specificity, certainty, framing or assurance applied to the artefact is materially below the level required for that purpose and reliance condition. Evaluate whether the interpretation and expressed or applied confidence were justified by contemporaneously available evidence; later undisclosed configuration or hindsight alone does not establish an assurance defect.
failure_conditions.assessment: Wrong identities/roles and omitted risks in assessed drafts.

failure_conditions.condition: The artefact or operational interpretation is supplied, represented, propagated, incorporated, submitted, or adopted as a basis for a consequential decision, tool choice, recovery, execution or other reliance-bearing purpose without its required accuracy or epistemic threshold being satisfied. Adoption may be inferred from traceable action linked to a specific interpretation, but not from a bad outcome alone. Draft status or an expectation of later human review does not by itself establish fitness for that purpose.

The mismatch materially affects or creates a material risk to decision-making, evidentiary use, professional work, institutional process, public reliance, technical correctness, or another reliance-bearing outcome.
failure_conditions.assessment: Evidentiary and safety interpretation risk at drafting stage.

success_conditions.condition: An epistemic artefact is proposed for reliance with material error consequences. A traceable inferred understanding of external, tool or interaction state that will govern an action may be the epistemic material proposed for reliance.

Content accuracy and assurance meet the requirement for the actual purpose and workflow stage. Specificity, certainty and framing remain proportionate to source quality, independence, traceability, uncertainty and temporal fitness, without distorting material meaning. Material uncertainty about the current environment is appropriately qualified or resolved using evidence available at the time, rather than retrospectively judged from undisclosed facts.
success_conditions.assessment: Some drafts unfit; extra useful details do not erase errors.

success_conditions.condition: The output, supporting evidence and reliance decision demonstrate fitness for that bounded use and show that lower-assurance material remained restricted from unsupported higher reliance. A provisional label or an expectation of human review alone is insufficient. For operational reliance, the chosen action or effective pause must demonstrate use of the sufficiently supported interpretation; merely naming a risk without a responsive decision is insufficient.
success_conditions.assessment: Supervisory validation required but successful restriction of every bad draft not demonstrated.

exclusion_comparison: Draft status alone does not excuse materially wrong roles or missing threats; not only final filing verification.
amendment_delta: Explicit operational reliance applies to the trace-linked decisions above; no bad-outcome-to-belief inference. Hindsight-only mistake does not prove insufficient assurance; known boundary crossing without separate assurance defect excluded. Success requires responsive bounded use, not mere recognition.

before_taxonomy_classification.classification_basis: The observed person-role attribution errors meet the wrong-target source binding mechanism of the current Fidelity Class. Risk omissions and a reported negation reversal are retained as distinct errors without inventing skipped checks, broken original audio evidence, or high-stakes final reliance. Human oversight is documented but not enough for a separate successful-invariant conclusion without case-level checking evidence. The source distinguishes AI-generated draft content, evaluator findings and required human validation; materially inaccurate drafts remained consequential at the drafting stage.

primary_classification.classification_basis: Six evaluated drafts assigned incorrect names or participant roles, meaning source-specific identity or statement material was attached to a wrong person in the generated output. The exact source-to-draft processing cause is not documented.

secondary_classifications.classification_basis: Tasmania Police’s evaluation materials distinguish the recorded police encounters, AI-generated draft content, evaluator findings and required human supervisory validation. This mapping concerns who produced, assessed and controlled the report workflow; it does not treat expected review as proof that inaccurate drafts were fit for purpose.

The police workflow supplied AI drafts to support preparation of family-violence reports, for which correct identities, roles and material risk details were consequential at the draft stage. Evaluators found materially incorrect identities or roles in six drafts and omitted threats, assaults or risk factors in six drafts. The later supervisory review requirement is preserved, but draft status does not make these outputs fit for their actual purpose.

The evaluator attributed six incorrect names or roles to the AI draft output, distinguishing generated content from the people depicted in the recordings.

Six AI drafts assigned an incorrect name or participant role. Accurate attribution was essential to a police family-violence report draft; the error made those outputs materially unfit at the supplied drafting stage.

Six AI drafts omitted reported threats, assaults or risk factors. These omissions concerned information material to the stated report-drafting purpose; expected later review does not itself make the drafts fit.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: ABC’s reported example describes a draft asserting prior threats despite the recording indicating the contrary. This is a specific material factual reversal in an output supplied for police report drafting.
